item.title_tr: Xiaomi Poco X7 PRO 5G 512GB+12GB RAM, 256GB+12GB RAM Dimensity Processor 8400-Ultra, 50MP Camera, 6000Mah Battery Version
item.description_tr:
The Special Edition Iron Man features a custom design and interface, a stylized USB cable (only this variation is included; the power adapter and bluetooth headphones are free gifts), and the other colors are not included.

Technical Specifications:
PROCESSOR
Dimensity 8400-Ultra 4 nm manufacturing process
CPU: Octa-core CPU up to 3.25 GHz GPU: Mali-G720

Storage: 512GB + 12GB RAM

Screen
6.67" AMOLED CrystalRes screen. Resolution: 2712 x 1220 (1.5K resolution) Refresh rate: Up to 120 Hz. Touch sampling rate: 480 Hz touch sampling rate, 2560 instant touch sampling rate. Hz, 16X super-resolution touch
*The 2560 Hz instant touch sampling rate is only compatible with game turbo mode enabled.

REAR CAMERA
50MP main camera with OISOISf/1.5 aperture, 4-in-1 composition for a super pixel of 1.6μm, 1/1.95" sensor size, 6PC lens, 8MP ultra-wide-angle camera with f/2.2 aperture, rear camera photography features.
Dynamic captures | Focus of motion tracking | Motion capture | 50 MP mode | Film camera | Portrait Mode | Documents | Night mode | Pro Mode | Panorama | HDR Video recording with the rear camera
4K video recording: 24 fps/30 fps/60 fps
1080p video recording: 30/60 fps
720p video recording: 30fps. Slow motion camera: 1080p at 120fps/240fps/960fps.
Slow motion: 720p at 120 fps/240 fps/960 fps
Rear camera video features
Director Mode | Pro video mode | Video recording format | ShootSteady | Slow motion camera | Dual video | Time lapse

Front camera
20 MPOV20B front camera (1/4" sensor size) f/2.2, 4-element lens, soft light ring. | Beautifier with AI | Night mode | Portrait mode. Video recording with the front camera: 1080p at 30 fps, 720p at 30 fps.

BATTERY AND CHARGING
6000mAh (typ.) 90W Hyper Charge
90W charger included in the box. USB-C.
Note: The charger pin design may vary depending on the batch received.
And therefore cannot exchange it.


SECURITY
In-screen fingerprint Sensor. facial recognition unlock with AI.

Network and Connectivity
Dual SIM, dual standby (5G+5G, 5G+4G) Compatible with 5G*/4G/3G/2G

Audio
Dual Dolby Atmos speakers®

Sensors
Proximity Sensor | 360° ambient light Sensor° | Accelerometer | Oscillation Sensor | Electronic compass | IR Blaster | Gyroscope | X-axis linear vibration Motor

Operating system
Xiaomi HyperOS 2
